name.ja: <ruby>六<rt>りっ</rt></ruby><ruby>花<rt>か</rt></ruby><ruby>双<rt>そう</rt></ruby><ruby>精<rt>せい</rt></ruby>プリムローズ

text.en: If a monster(s) is Tributed: You can Special Summon this card from your hand and 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck, except "Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy", in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can target 1 Plant monster you control; increase or decrease its Level by 2. During your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Plant Xyz Monster. You can only use each effect of "Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy" once per turn.
